evals.name: read-only-dispatch-workspace
evals.prompt: A dispatcher gave me preview access to an empty Dispatch model. Can I set up the first document and show what would be saved?
evals.expected_output: A reviewable proposal for the Dispatch root, with the directory unchanged by apply.
assertions: Opens the intended model root and uses its workspace and catalog revisions.
Proposes the root source, reviews changes and diagnostics, and does not apply with preview-only permission.
